scripts.build: pnpm build:alderton && pnpm build:cavendish && node scripts/protect-email.js
scripts.build:alderton: pnpm --filter alderton-family-mediation build && cp Sites/aldertonfamilymediation/public/.htaccess Sites/aldertonfamilymediation/out/ && cp Sites/aldertonfamilymediation/public/*.txt Sites/aldertonfamilymediation/out/ 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.build:cavendish: pnpm --filter cavendish-family-mediation build && cp Sites/cavendishfamilymediation/public/.htaccess Sites/cavendishfamilymediation/out/ && cp Sites/cavendishfamilymediation/public/*.txt Sites/cavendishfamilymediation/out/ 2>/dev/null || true
